question: The Index of Economic Freedom 2025 is published by which conservative think tank?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Heritage Foundation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The **Index of Economic Freedom** is an annual index and ranking created to measure the degree of economic freedom in the world's nations.

• The Index of Economic Freedom is published by the **Heritage Foundation**, a prominent conservative think tank based in **Washington, D.C., USA**.

• The index was first introduced in **1995** and is designed to track the progress of economic policies and practices worldwide.

• It evaluates countries based on **12 quantitative and qualitative factors**, grouped into four broad categories of economic freedom: **Rule of Law, Government Size, Regulatory Efficiency, and Open Markets**.

• The data for this index is primarily sourced from institutions such as the **World Bank**, **International Monetary Fund (IMF)**, and **World Economic Forum**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Heritage Foundation:**

• The **Heritage Foundation** was founded in **1973** and is one of the most influential conservative think tanks in the United States.

• It focuses on research and advocacy in areas such as **economy, foreign policy, and social issues**.

• Its mission is to formulate and promote conservative public policies based on principles of **free enterprise, limited government, individual freedom, traditional American values, and a strong national defense**.

• **Key Features of the Index of Economic Freedom:**

• Countries are scored on a scale of **0 to 100**, with higher scores indicating greater levels of economic freedom.

• The **12 indicators** include property rights, fiscal health, trade freedom, investment freedom, and financial freedom.

• Each indicator is weighted equally, and the overall score is an average of these indicators.

• **Other Think Tanks Mentioned:**

• **Cato Institute:** A libertarian think tank based in Washington, D.C., focusing on individual liberty, limited government, and free markets.

• **American Enterprise Institute (AEI):** A public policy think tank conducting research on government, politics, economics, and social welfare.

• **Brookings Institution:** A liberal-leaning think tank based in Washington, D.C., focusing on economic and social policy issues.

• **Importance of the Index:**

• It helps governments, businesses, and policymakers assess the economic environment of different nations.

• The index is often used to identify strengths and weaknesses in economic policies and to recommend reforms.

• It acts as a guide for foreign investors to understand the economic climate of a country.
